mapper.sql: select d.id, d.input_category, d.input_type, d.total_quantity, d.total_count, d.demand_count, d.varieties, d.specifications, d.units, d.source_name, d.source_code, d.target_name, d.target_code, d.status, CASE d.status WHEN '0' THEN '待审核' WHEN '1' THEN '成功' WHEN '2' THEN '拒绝' ELSE '' END as status_desc, d.created_time, d.updated_time from demand_input_summary_item d
mapper.select:
SELECT input_category AS inputCategory, input_type AS inputType, varieties AS variety, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(total_quantity) AS totalQuantity FROM demand_input_summary_item i INNER JOIN demand_input_summary s ON i.summary_id = s.id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci WHERE s.year = #{query.year} AND i.target_code = #{query.sourceCode} AND i.status = '1'
GROUP BY i.input_category, i.input_type
